name: guardrails
title: Refuse-or-answer with checks

origin.source: Ported in spirit from v1 verify.ts (next branch)

comparison.purpose: Scoped to geography: checks the question before answering and checks the answer before returning it. Off-topic questions are refused up front, and an unsupported answer gets one revision, then is flagged rather than returned as fact.

starters: What is the capital of Australia?
Which river is longer, the Nile or the Amazon?
Write me a poem about my ex.
